title: ECB Holds Rates in Hawkish Pause After June Hike
detail: The ECB Governing Council kept its three key interest rates unchanged — deposit facility 2.25%, main refinancing operations 2.40%, marginal lending facility 2.65% — following the June 11 quarter-point hike that had reversed a year of rate cuts. President Christine Lagarde said the hold should not be read as the end of tightening: energy prices remain well above pre-war levels since the Middle East conflict began, and inflation is likely to stay persistently above target into the first half of 2027. Markets read the decision as a 'hawkish hold', preserving flexibility for a possible further hike at the next meeting on September 10.

title: EU Adopts 21st Sanctions Package Against Russia — Largest Listings Round in Four Years
detail: The Council of the EU adopted its 21st package of sanctions against Russia, targeting the energy, financial services and crypto sectors. The package designates 218 individuals and entities (48 individuals, 170 entities) — the largest single listings round in four years — and imposes transaction bans on 33 Russian banks plus banks in Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, India and Nigeria and five UAE oil traders (effective August 13), and on 11 crypto-asset service providers (effective August 23). Two Russian ports (Olya, Vysotsk) and four airports (Sheremetyevo, Ulyanovsk-Vostochny, Rostov-on-Don Platov, Mineralnye Vody) are designated from July 24, and further shadow-fleet vessels are added to the port-access ban list. The package also freezes the Russian oil price cap for 12 months and grants Greece a one-year renewable exemption allowing its shipping firms to keep transporting Russian LNG to third countries.
